items.title: NVIDIA Or Micron: Which Gets Paid More Safely For The AI Shortage?
items.summary: If you own NVIDIA (NVDA) or Micron Technology (MU), you own the same idea: AI data centers want more chips and memory than the industry can supply. The two split from there. NVIDIA is putting its own balance sheet behind some of its biggest buyers. Micron's buyers are posting cash deposits to secure its memory, so the money flows in opposite directions.
